name: PontPont Hand-bag Shop (Next.js & Flutter)
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'if [ ! -x "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" ]; then git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"; fi && "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" --version && "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" config --enable-web && cd /workspaces/PontPont-Hand-bag-shop && npm install && (cd pontpont_mobile && "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" pub get)'
